entities.summary: Boyan Danovski (b. 1899-08-19, Ruse) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Ruse and Bulgaria. Known in the fields of bulgaria, poets & playwrights, europe.
